title: Air Force and CIA created two weeks after Roswell
summary: Jake Barber tells of Air Force and CIA created two weeks after Roswell, about 1947 at Roswell, New Mexico, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: since its inception in 1947, like two weeks after Roswell incident, you get the National Security Act, you get the formation of the Air Force, CIA at the same time,

plain: Jake Barber, a man who says he flew a helicopter to recover a UFO, points out that in 1947, about two weeks after the Roswell incident, a reported crash of a flying object near Roswell, New Mexico, the National Security Act was passed. That law, he says, created the US Air Force and the CIA at the same time. To him this suggests the system of secrecy was built around the crash from the start.
